plain: Brent Friedman is a Hollywood writer. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says that about five years ago, during COVID, he was in a hospital intensive care unit with sepsis, a life-threatening reaction of the body to infection. One night, lying there alone, he says light beings suddenly came to the foot of his bed, three of them. If true, it would mean beings of light visit people near death. He mentions it again on a later episode of the same show, describing being on his deathbed and watching light beings come to the foot of his bed. That second telling gives no number of beings and no date, and its notes tie it to a cancer illness rather than COVID. Both tellings are Brent's own, given on two different episodes.
